TableColumnHeader.description: A column's header cell, a `<th>`. It carries `aria-sort` while its column is sorted, spans the columns a group header stands over, and holds the column's size and pinned offset as custom properties.

props.header: The header this cell is for: one of `group.headers` from `table.getHeaderGroups()`, or of `table.getFlatHeaders()`.

dataAttributes.data-sorted: `asc` or `desc` while the column is sorted.
dataAttributes.data-pinned: `start` or `end` while the column is pinned.
dataAttributes.data-resizing: Present while the column is being resized.
dataAttributes.data-placeholder: Present on a header that only fills the space above a column in a deeper header group.

cssVariables.--column-start: On a column pinned to the start: its distance from the table's start edge.
cssVariables.--column-end: On a column pinned to the end: its distance from the table's end edge.

TableSortTrigger.description: A button that sorts by its column: ascending, descending, then unsorted, in the order the column's options give. With Shift held it adds the column to the sort. Disabled for a column that can't be sorted. Put it in the column's header cell.

dataAttributes.data-sorted: `asc` or `desc` while the column is sorted.
dataAttributes.data-sort-index: Where the column stands among the sorted columns, from 0.
dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the column can't be sorted.

TableColumnResizer.description: A handle that resizes its column by dragging. It is a focusable `separator` whose value is the column's size: the arrow keys resize it, Home and End go to its smallest and largest size, and a double click puts the size back. Give it an `aria-label` that names the column.

props.header: The header whose column the handle resizes.
props.step: Pixels an arrow key changes the size by.

dataAttributes.data-resizing: Present while the column is being resized.
dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the column can't be resized.

TableRow.description: A body row, a `<tr>`, with its state as `data-*` attributes to style by.

dataAttributes.data-selected: Present while the row is selected.
dataAttributes.data-expanded: Present while the row is expanded.
dataAttributes.data-grouped: Present on a group's own row.
dataAttributes.data-depth: How deep the row is in a tree or under group rows, from 0.
dataAttributes.data-pinned: `top` or `bottom` while the row is pinned.

TableCell.description: A body cell, a `<td>`, with its column's size and pinned offset as custom properties.

dataAttributes.data-pinned: `start` or `end` while the column is pinned.
dataAttributes.data-grouped: In a group's row: present on the cell that names the group.
dataAttributes.data-aggregated: In a group's row: present on a cell that holds the group's aggregate.
dataAttributes.data-placeholder: Under a group: present on the grouped column's cell, which stays empty.

cssVariables.--column-start: On a column pinned to the start: its distance from the table's start edge.
cssVariables.--column-end: On a column pinned to the end: its distance from the table's end edge.

TableSelectRow.description: A checkbox that selects its row: a CheckboxRoot wired to the table. Shift with a press selects every row from the last one pressed to this one. It is mixed while only some of the row's sub-rows are selected, and disabled for a row that can't be selected. Labelled "Select row": pass an `aria-label` that names the row.

dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the row can't be selected.

TableSelectAll.description: A checkbox that selects every row, or every row on the current page: checked when all are selected, mixed when some are. A CheckboxRoot wired to the table, labelled "Select all rows".

props.scope: Which rows the box stands for: `all`, or the rows on the current `page`.

TableExpandTrigger.description: A button that shows and hides what is under its row: sub-rows, a group's rows, or a detail row the app renders while `row.getIsExpanded()`. It carries `aria-expanded`, and is disabled for a row with nothing under it.

dataAttributes.data-expanded: Present while the row is expanded.
dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the row has nothing to show.

TableColumnFilter.description: A text input that filters by its column: rows are kept while the column's value matches what is typed, as the column's `filterFn` decides. Empty means no filter. Disabled for a column that can't be filtered.

dataAttributes.data-filtered: Present while the column has a filter.

TableGlobalFilter.description: A search input over every column that allows it: rows are kept while any of those columns matches. Empty means no filter.

dataAttributes.data-filtered: Present while there is a search.

TableColumnToggle.description: A checkbox that shows and hides its column: a CheckboxRoot wired to the table. Disabled for a column that can't be hidden. Label it with the column's name.

props.column: The column to show and hide.

dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the column can't be hidden.

TablePagination.description: A PaginationRoot whose page is the table's. Put Pagination's own parts inside it, and read `use pagination` for the page numbers.

props.siblingCount: Pages shown on each side of the current one.
props.boundaryCount: Pages always shown at the start and at the end.
